objects.description: Extends STIX 2.1 with features to create Attack Flows.

objects.name: Detection technique coverage: kubernetes-abuse-of-secret-by-unusual-user-agent
objects.description: The following analytic detects unauthorized access or misuse of Kubernetes Secrets by unusual user agents. It leverages Kubernetes Audit logs to identify anomalies in access patterns by analyzing the source of requests based on user agents. This activity is significant for a SOC because Kubernetes Secrets store sensitive information like passwords, OAuth tokens, and SSH keys, making them critical assets. If confirmed malicious, this activity could lead to unauthorized access to sensitive systems
